question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Did you want Hector and Amanda to break up?
What is your favorite thing about summer?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not a big deal. I told her we'd go shopping. I'll stick with it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: One more store.
A short time later...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! Thanks so much for coming with me!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I bought these...
Amanda moves her feet in new sandals that show off her long, tanned legs.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ooh... I like those...
She hands him one of the shopping bags dangling off her arm.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Want me to carry that?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes! But only because it's for you! For shopping with me!
Hector opens the bag, reaches in, and pulls out a sophisticated sweater.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, thanks, Amanda. Where'd you buy a sweater in summer?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I have my ways.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I bought it for you, so you don't get cold the next time you shave an ice unicorn for me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is a nice sweater, but are we really at the boring stage when she's buying me clothes?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Come on, let's go!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, I can't do this! I hate shoes!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Gasp! How could you say that? When they're right on your own two feet!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm not going to go into another store!
Frustrated, Hector slams an open palm on a display table. High-heels and ballet flats fly everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Gasp! No!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sniffle... Sniffle... You're so angry...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda... Don't cry. I'm just frustrated...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm... Sniffle... So upset! Don't talk to me... I'm... I'm going shopping!
Amanda disappears deep inside the store.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Way to go, patience.
Hector walks dejectedly outside.
An hour later, Amanda walks out to the boardwalk, her arms laden with several shopping bags.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Much better! They gave me a discount on the shoes because you yelled at me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, sorry about that. Let me get some of those bags.
Everyone breaks and goes their separate directions.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Now come on!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, okay... But can we just go to one clothing store this time?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Four.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Two.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Six!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Deal!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait... Weren't you were supposed to say 'three'?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Math. It's so weird, right?
Amanda drags Hector to the boardwalk.
So they shop...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Pretty! Look at these cute shoes!
And shop...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Shiny! Look at these unicorn necklaces!
And shop...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Trendy! Look at these clutch purses!
Until...
Amanda drags Hector into one last store.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! Colorful! Look at these strappy sandals!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Can we move on now, Amanda? We've been at the boardwalk forever.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You said six stores!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Going to the same store three times is like going to three different stores!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm almost done. Besides I just saw a flip-flop sale we can't pass up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You shouldn't shun a sunny shoe sale at the Seashell Shoe Shack!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Was that... Was that English?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Just this one last store, Hector? Please?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All Amanda wants to do is shop...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Can't a guy have his freedom? I am getting bored!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, no, just accept this. You can deal with this. Calm down, Hector. There's only one more store!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector's, like, my number one fashion consultant!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Dude, isn't that kind of embarrassing?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not when it's summer.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What does that have to do with anything?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm just saying there's nothing embarrassing about watching your girlfriend try on mini-skirts and bikinis.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Touche, sir.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: That is a good point!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, we'll leave you to it then! Have fun playing `fashion consultant.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, we'll leave you to it then! Have fun playing [color=#e23b3b][i]fashion consultant.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Aww, Hector! That's really sweet!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yep. That's so `precious.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yep. That's so [color=#e23b3b][i]precious.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: And a little embarrassing.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why is it embarrassing? I love her.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: You love her so much you carry all her bags and give her opinions on girly things?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Nothing, nothing.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm saying Amanda is just really lucky to have a man like you to push around.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I am lucky!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, we'll leave you to it then!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or did you mean something else?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What am I doing? I can't do this to Amanda over the phone!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll do it face-to-face. I owe her that much.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't understand. Can you say it differently?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, it's okay! I'm fine. I had nothing to say, really. Not at all.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Goodbye! See you there!
Hector hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, I can do this. I can break up with Amanda. I'm just going to do it at the beach party.
Half an hour later, Hector arrives at the beach.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I want to get this done quickly. Where is Amanda?
Around him, cheerleaders set up beach umbrellas and a large pinata...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whoa, this pinata is bulky! And I don't know even known how we're going to hang it up!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe we should just leave it on the ground and bat at it...
Next to them, some of the guys are grilling meat...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hamburgers! I like them extra crispy!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But don't use that much lighter fluid!
And the nerds run around calculating the trigonometric angles of their battle kites.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Your kite is obtuse!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't let it hear you say that!
Over by a table, Amanda is setting up snacks for everyone. Phil and Jacob stand nearby talking to her.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You're looking good today, Amanda. Glad we're having some sweet swimsuit weather.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, it's delicious!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda's totally hot. If I break things off now... She'll have a new boyfriend in an instant!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I can't break up with her! What was I thinking?! That was a dumb idea in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: It's really cool that you're into basketball. Most girls don't like it.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, really. Anyway, you look warm, Amanda. You want anything to drink?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sure!
Hector grabs a soda from a cooler and walks over to Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is for you, babe.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector! You made it!
Hector leans down and kisses Amanda deeply!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mmmmph!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mmmmm...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Uh, we'll just head out now.
Jacob and Phil leave. After a long moment, Hector pulls away.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't need to listen to what Party Hector says! I'm just going to forget all about him!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda and I can make this work. We're perfect together. I'm happy with her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hector, you're finally here! Less making out, more moving! Set the speakers and music over there by the fire pit. `Now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hector, you're finally here! Less making out, more moving! Set the speakers and music over there by the fire pit. [color=#3b78e2][i]Now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, all right. Don't rush the music genius!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: See you later!
Hector walks towards the beach fire pit where Howard and $ZOE are stacking wooden logs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello, Hector! Glad you could join us!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah. You know, is it me, or are there more nerds than usual at this beach party? Taylor's going to have a fit.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She shouldn't. She invited all of them.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What, really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. Maybe she's feeling nice because it's the `last day of summer.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. Maybe she's feeling nice because it's the [color=#3b78e2][i]last day of summer.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, don't remind me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, speaking of nerds, have you heard from Brendan? He's on a big date with Dinah, but he said he might come by.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, man. I haven't heard from him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never mind. I'll text him later. Need any help setting things up?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nope. I have it all right here in my bag. Got to hurry up if I'm going to enjoy some sun with Amanda.
Hector reaches into his backpack, fishes around, and pulls out... A thick book!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That isn't music.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, it's my book... It's `The H.E.C.T.O.R. Method.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it's my book... It's [color=#e23b3b][i]The H.E.C.T.O.R. Method.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that the book you wrote on dating?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, but what is this doing here? I didn't put it in... Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Party Animal Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He knows! He's watching!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector, what are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you eat some of that weird jerky that we found in your uncle's fridge?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nothing!
Hector pushes the book back into his backpack and spends the next fifteen minutes setting up the sound system.
A little later, everything is ready for partying!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whew! Glad that's over.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A day at the beach... The sun, the waves, the surf... Now I can finally relax.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll say! The first thing I'm going to do is take a nap!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'm going to sunbathe for a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Count me in on that one, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, Jacob, want to throw around the frisbee?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Make it a football, and you're on!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I'm going to...
Amanda comes up and links arms with Hector!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `We're` going to shop!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We're[/i][/color] going to shop!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, you can shop at the beach?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, no, but you can shop at the boardwalk!
Amanda points down to the edge of the pier, where small stores are waiting, and smiles up at Hector.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Let's go! I've been so excited about the summer blowout sales!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great. Shopping.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ugh, I don't want to go. But I can't tell her that. We can't break up.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Haha, have fun, man.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: He will! Hector loves shopping!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Oh really? Why?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh...

options.label: I like watching Amanda try on clothes.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't understand... You're breaking up?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I can hear you just fine!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't understand... We're on the phone.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I can't see you anyway!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And you know the worst part? You've lost sight of who you are as a player!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You used to be able to flirt with the hottest and most popular girls! You could convince them to leave their boyfriends for you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But now... Instead of being the one to score a date with a hot cheerleader, you `became` one.
nodes.text_bbcode: But now... Instead of being the one to score a date with a hot cheerleader, you [color=#e23b3b][i]became[/i][/color] one.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, man... Hector Law numero uno... `Have some respect.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, man... Hector Law numero uno... [color=#e23b3b][i]Have some respect.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can't give my own seminar back to me.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why not? Someone has to put the sense back in you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Do you remember what middle school was like? We were nerds!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The H.E.C.T.O.R. method was the system you created to stop being lame.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't forget what you've worked for. Don't go back down that road.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's what you're doing by staying with `Amanda.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what you're doing by staying with [color=#e23b3b][i]Amanda.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...You might be right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Of course I am! I'm you! Now you're beginning to make sense!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And if you're going to break up, you have to do it before the end of summer!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know why... Taylor starts the ranking of the boys.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You start the year in a relationship that goes sour, you're branded for the rest of the year.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No girl wants to be the rebound relationship.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But you start the year single? You're a blank slate, ready to be filled with dates...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think you're talking about an appointment book...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, that's the spirit! Now, no more waiting. You know what you have to do.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And remember, I'll be watching everything you do.
Hector blinks...
And stands once again in darkness.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Amanda.
At home, Hector contemplates his options.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Party Hector is right... If I don't do it now, it'll never happen.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But it's not the end of the world. Couples break up and get back together all the time.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe it's just not right for us now, but it'll be okay later...
With a heavy heart, Hector picks up the phone and calls Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hello? Hello?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda... I want to talk to you. Are you busy right now?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! And so are you!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, what do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Taylor's beach party is today.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You know... The one she throws at the end of summer.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're supposed to be here to set up the music system.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: She says if you don't come now with your music collection, she's going to stuff your speakers... Somewhere bad.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh yeah, the beach party, I totally forgot...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I would have too if I weren't already here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll be right over.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wait... Didn't you want to tell me something?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, listen, I think we should... Uh... I think we should... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no, Hector! You're stuck on repeat!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry. I meant to say we should...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's what I thought you'd say.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're too stubborn to see what you've become...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `A boring loser.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]A boring loser.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not only have you been with Amanda for over a year...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You do everything for her! You shop with her every day `and` carry all her bags!
nodes.text_bbcode: You do everything for her! You shop with her every day [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] carry all her bags!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You two have stupid pet names for each other!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You sculpt ice unicorns for her!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm surprised at you. I thought you'd tell me 'no way' for sure.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm glad you're eager to know why. It shows you can learn.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Are you going to answer the question or what?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, I didn't want to be the one to say this, but you've lost your edge.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not only are you boring, but you're bored! You shop with her every day. You don't even make out that much.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're sappy. You have stupid names for each other.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And worse, you're wrapped around her finger!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's not true!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dogg, you sculpted an ice unicorn for her!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Also, you stopped saying

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well... She kept getting confused...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: How about it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now you're lame `and` boring?
nodes.text_bbcode: Now you're lame [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] boring?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can still love Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And Brittany...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And Tina...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And Megan...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't think you know what words mean...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And that's not what I was getting at.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've been together for a long time. You gave it a good shot.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But now you have to break it off!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, she is!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...But wait, that's it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Of course not, but knowing you, er, me, it was an argument you couldn't refuse.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, you're right. She is hot.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But there are other hot, single redheads in the world.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Which is why you have to break up with the one you have right now. Opportunities, man.
And bursts into the mall!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wait, this isn't where the mall is supposed to be... This makes no sense!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What doesn't make sense, dear?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gah! Where'd you come from?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm always by your side! Now come on, let's go shopping!
Around Hector, racks and racks of clothes pop up, reaching as far as the eye can see...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's wrong? Don't want to shop? But who will carry my stuff? I only have two arms...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But... I hate shopping!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't be silly. We'll go shopping and be together forever and ever...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And ever... `AND EVER...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And ever... [color=#3b78e2][i]AND EVER...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Amanda grabs his hand with both of hers.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Amanda, but I can't...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No, I'm sorry... Because I need you to come along!
Amanda's third hand clamps onto Hector's other hand. Another hand tries to pull Hector into a hug...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Stay back, Octo-Girlfriend! `Aiiieeeee!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Stay back, Octo-Girlfriend! [color=#e23b3b][i]Aiiieeeee!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hector breaks away, stumbling backwards. He reaches the doors and runs through...
Into an auditorium!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've got to help me! Somebody! Anybody!
Suddenly the lights dim...
And the spotlight turns out, pointing to the center of the stage!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Welcome to Hector's Guide to Girls... I'm your host... Party Animal Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Party Hector! You've got to get me out of here... Amanda... She's...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Trying to make you be someone you're not?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually, I was going to say

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A `shoptopus,` if you will...
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#e23b3b][i]shoptopus,[/i][/color] if you will...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you brought this on yourself.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do I need to do to change this?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You already know...
Party Hector turns and walks off the stage. Hector tries to keep up, but falls!
He hits his head on the floor...
And finds himself sitting straight up in bed.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huff huff... Huff huff... That dream again?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've had enough of this! I need to know what `he's` talking about!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've had enough of this! I need to know what [color=#e23b3b][i]he's[/i][/color] talking about!

nodes.text: That night, Hector takes an unexpected trip to his uncle's lakehouse cabin!
He bursts into the house and flings open the door to the sauna!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Party Animal Hector! I know you're here! We need to talk!
Hector steps in, and the door closes shut behind him. Heat seeps into his clothes.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right. Come out, come out wherever you are...
No one answers.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll sit here until you show up!
He sits down and blinks...
When Hector opens his eyes, he's sitting in an amphitheater. Party Animal Hector stands at the podium.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Welcome to Hector's Guide to Girls.
Hector jumps onstage and shoves Party Animal Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, cut the crap. I know you've been sending me dreams.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ever since I came here and saw you in my vision, I've been having the same dream every night.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So I think you should explain yourself, you crummy-suit-wearing dream weirdo!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You... Are aware that we're the same person, right? And that you're the one who purchased this suit?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Okay, fine, it's a sharp suit. It looks great on you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Thank you! I love the cut!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And, okay, I'll admit, your hair looks amazing. How do you get it to have that glossy shine?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Three different types of conditioner!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh, I should try that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! Stay on topic! Why do you keep haunting my dreams?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Explain something to me. Why are you still with Amanda?
Hector swings at Nerdy Hector, but his punch goes straight through him!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ooh, that tickled.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gah! You're a ghost!
Hector falls back and scrambles to his feet! He runs out of the classroom...
Hector scrambles out of his seat.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You can't run away from this, Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Watch me!
Hector runs to the door and turns the handle, sparing a glance back.
Nerdy Hector makes no move to follow him.
Hector flings open the door, runs out...
Hector panics and freezes!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What, you aren't going to do anything?
Nerdy Hector takes a step towards Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: N... No! Get away from me!
Hector runs out of the classroom...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Don't talk, don't talk, don't talk...
Taylor turns back to Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, why can't you?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, Taylor. I can't do it because I don't think sunscreen will help...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Of course sunscreen will help. It's a `sun`burn.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course sunscreen will help. It's a [color=#3b78e2][i]sun[/i][/color]burn.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: For burns, aloe lotion is better. It has anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving properties.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Plus, it moisturizes.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ooh... Where do I get that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I have some in my bag.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I carry it with me when I go to the beach. The sun hates me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, show me the lotion already.
Brendan leads Taylor to where his stuff is.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Getting in touch with cheerleaders? Man, those were the days...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, it was... Refreshing.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You used to be good at it, too.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I played in the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And why did you stop? Because of your `girlfriend.` Isn't it a drag having to keep track of her all the time?
nodes.text_bbcode: And why did you stop? Because of your [color=#e23b3b][i]girlfriend.[/i][/color] Isn't it a drag having to keep track of her all the time?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not all the time!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I made her sad because I didn't want to shop.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Doesn't it suck to be controlled by tears? Jerked around like some kind of pathetic tear-puppet?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's a very confusing image...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I tried... Once. On the phone. Before the beach.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I didn't tell you to `try.` I told you to `do it!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't tell you to [color=#e23b3b][i]try.[/i][/color] I told you to [color=#e23b3b][i]do it![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay. Maybe I... Maybe I lost sight of why I had to do it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll tell you why. It's right in front of your face. Don't you see what you've become? Remember what happened at the boardwalk?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: When was I supposed to do it, huh? In the middle of setting up? When she wanted to go shopping?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: In front of our friends?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I guess you make a good point.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But is there ever a good time to have the break-up talk?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I knew you turned into a loser, but I didn't realize you were a wuss too.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Party Hector, you're really mean.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Only because I'm just seeing how far you've fallen.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'It's hard.' Of course it's hard! What did you expect it to be like? A walk in the park?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Breaking up with girls is just something that players do.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll... I'll do it, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You will?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: S... Sure... I'll lather my hands in suntan lotion... And then slather you in it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Gently caressing your smooth, perfect alabaster skin... Feeling the warmth of your body...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: OMG, why do guys always have to make this so creepy? I have a burn on my back.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I just want someone to put something on it, so it doesn't get gross.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh. This is why I don't deal with nerds.
Taylor turns away and walks off to get the other cheerleaders to help her.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Hector!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hector![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Why'd you open your mouth? Now Taylor thinks I'm a dweeb again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't think that opinion ever changed.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's not the point! The point is... I just broke up with Dinah, and now I feel worse!
Brendan storms off in the other direction to be alone.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice, Hector, but this isn't just going to go away in an instant.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm sorry, man. I wish I could help you more.
Hector looks over and sees the cheerleaders chatting and giggling at something the football players are saying.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually, I can. Come on.
Hector guides Brendan over to the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What are you doing?! Where are we going? Is this going to hurt?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think I know what will cheer you up...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A `cheerleader!`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#e23b3b][i]cheerleader![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait, Hector... I don't want to talk to girls. I just broke up with one.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm not ready to move on.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Relax. You're not moving on. You're just going to have a normal conversation with a girl that isn't Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just to remind you they exist.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay...
Hector looks over at the cheerleaders. Maria, Nicole, and Jessica are playing in the surf, while Taylor sits alone on a towel.
Hector marches Brendan up to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: H... Hey, Taylor. I'm sorry I was late, but I finally showed up, but only after a pretty long night with...
Hector nudges Brendan. He shuts up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you're just in time.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I need some help. I was out in the sun all day, and I got a sunburn on my back, but I can't reach it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Can one of you help me rub some sunscreen on it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no! I can't do it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What is wrong with this kid? You don't refuse a girl when she asks you that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She's giving him a great opportunity, and he's totally screwing up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, isn't `someone` going to help me?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color] going to help me?

nodes.text: Taylor looks at Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I need to step in! ...No, wait, I can't offer to do that for Taylor. I have a girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I need to stay out of it.

nodes.prompt: Stay out of it! Let Brendan talk!
nodes.title: Keep quiet!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's like a meditation thing. When my uncle went to Tibet to join the monks, he told me about this.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You'll get over Dinah faster if you accept that you're going to be down.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How is thinking about how much it hurts supposed to help?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think when you realize that it is going to hurt no matter what, it makes you feel better.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I don't want to think about it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, it's going to be on your mind. You might as well embrace the fact you're going to be miserable.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess that's kind of comforting. I think.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I'll distract myself. How am I supposed to do that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Right now, everything reminds me of her. The moon rising over the horizon, the dark ocean waters...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, don't look at the water, and stop appreciating the moon! Why don't you go run around or something?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, the cliffs are over there. Why don't you run there and back?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dinah would have loved the longing of the void that cliffs represents...
Hector pushes Brendan over.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, move! Move! Run! Run!
Startled, Brendan sprints towards the cliffs and back again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Do it again! Don't stop moving. Don't stop moving! `Lift those feet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do it again! Don't stop moving. Don't stop moving! [color=#e23b3b][i]Lift those feet![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brendan runs up and down the beach. Fifteen minutes later..

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huff huff... I'm not fit enough to distract myself!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wheeze... Wheeze...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm so glad my lungs feel just as broken as my heart.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, it was an idea.
Amanda wanders back to Hector and waves at Slick and Sly.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, hello, boys who look vaguely familiar!

nodes.speaker: Slick
nodes.text: Hello, Hector's girl.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, if you two don't mind, we're going to sunbathe for a while.

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Catch you on the single side!
Hector and Amanda rest on a beach towel, catching the last rays of sun.
As night falls, Howard starts a fire. Everyone starts roasting marshmallows...
When Brendan comes up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Brendan! There you are!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, guys... I got your text and decided to come.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Where's Dinah? Wasn't your big date tonight?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The thing is... Dinah and I broke up.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's a long and pretty interesting story... But I'd rather not talk about it if that's okay with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course, Brendan, I'm so sorry. Come over here. Let's toast some marshmallows.
Brendan sits down glumly.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm sorry, man.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought you wanted me and Dinah to break up.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I know... But that's only because it sounded like you were falling apart.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And we were. And even though it feels like the right thing, how come I still feel so bad?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Because breaking up is hard, man.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How do you know? Have you ever been through a break up?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh... I've stopped dating girls. And I know that sucks.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It must be nice being in such a solid relationship. You and Amanda have been dating for how long now?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not that long.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, it's been way over a year, right? I think you guys are going to make it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Unlike me and Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know, the best thing to do when you're down and broken-hearted is to...

nodes.prompt: The best thing to do is to...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: The best thing to do is to...

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: You always know what you're doing though!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's just it. I don't need to know what I'm doing next.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Being with Amanda is just it. I'm quite happy, thanks.

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, mostly...

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: That's good to hear.

nodes.speaker: Slick
nodes.text: But if you ever ditch her, let us know. We can look for girls together!

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Yeah, it's been so fun being single, man. All the clubs we can get into, all the girls we can dance with...

nodes.speaker: Slick
nodes.text: You know it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No thanks, guys. That doesn't sound like fun at all...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She actually is my long-term girlfriend. I'm not playing her, I'm not fooling her...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And I'm not moving on.

nodes.speaker: Slick
nodes.text: Sorry, man. I didn't mean to insult you.

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: But what you taught us is that everything is a game.

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: You just don't always know whose rules you're playing by.

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Are you in this relationship because you want it, or because you're telling yourself you should?
Howard sits in the sand as Amanda wanders farther down the beach to look at $ZOE and Howard's extensive sand community.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What will Party Hector think?
Suddenly the sun on Hector is blocked! Two familiar guys stand over him.

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Hey, if it isn't the Dating Master himself!

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Look, Slick, it's the guy we have to thank for teaching us how to pick up chicks!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What are you guys doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Prowling for chicks, man. It's like you said, 'You can find chicks anywhere'...

nodes.speaker: Slick
nodes.text: 'But on the beach, they're in bathing suits'!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I remember that... But Sly, I thought you were in a serious relationship.

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Yeah, me and this girl in my trig class used to run around together, but that's not the case anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: I don't think players are meant to be in long-term relationships.

nodes.speaker: Slick
nodes.text: Well, anyway, you're looking pretty happy with your redhead.

nodes.speaker: Slick
nodes.text: Wait a minute, is that the same one you were dating a year ago? Isn't that against the rules?

nodes.speaker: Sly
nodes.text: Yeah, man. What's your next step? You about to move on or what?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I want to swim in the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If that's fine with you.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, it's okay... I guess we can't do `everything` together.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, it's okay... I guess we can't do [color=#3b78e2][i]everything[/i][/color] together.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great!
Hector runs off to play with the rest of the cheerleaders in the water.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll just build the greatest sand castle ever!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: By myself.
In the ocean, Nicole, Jessica, and Maria play. Hector runs up to join them and splashes in the water with them.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's up, ladies? Anyone down for a splash war?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I am! I am!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: If you even try to dunk me, Hector, you're going down so fast...
Hector takes a step towards the girls...
Hector looks to the shore where Amanda is picking up a clump of sand and then dropping it back down, over and over again.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great, I'm in the surf with cheerleaders, and I can't even feel good about it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I feel like kind of a jerk now...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And if Party Hector were here, he'd tell me I wouldn't feel this way if I wasn't with Amanda...
Hector goes back to the beach. Amanda has created a large mound of sand. She is busy rubbing makeup onto it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It just doesn't look right!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What, uh, what do you have there?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I was trying to build a model of my house!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I got that... But why are you rubbing your makeup on it?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't you know, Hector? Every house needs to be built on a good `foundation!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you know, Hector? Every house needs to be built on a good [color=#3b78e2][i]foundation![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right. Well, um, on the bright side, that's a really nice hill you've got there.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks, Hecky-Wecky!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no! Lame nicknames? I really am in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I wish you had been here to help me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda, do you want me to show you how to make a sand garden now?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, sure!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can even check out our sand nursery where our sand babies are sleeping!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard did a really great job. I really admire his `sandy`work. Come on, I'll show you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard did a really great job. I really admire his [color=#3b78e2][i]sandy[/i][/color]work. Come on, I'll show you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Kill. Me. Now.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sigh. I'll stay here and build sand castles.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee! We'll build the greatest thing ever! You'll see.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What have I signed up for? Sand puppies? Sand unicorns?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Party Hector is never going to let me live this one down.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Where should we start?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you want to build?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I don't want a boring sand house or a sand castle. Let's make a sand-club!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Like a night club but with sand!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, that sounds really cool. We could put the DJ stand over here.
Hector molds sand together into a small platform.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And this is where everyone's going to dance to the music!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And wait until I build the subwoofer for this incredible band...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm going to make the decorations for the rest of the room!
Together, Amanda and Hector form a miniature version of a sand club.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There, that's the last of the stage lighting. What did you make, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I made us! Look, there's you and me on the dance floor. Having fun...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Like we always do.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... Like we always do.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I love you, Hecky-Wecky!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no! Lame nicknames? I really am in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Amanda, come check out our house!
Hector looks over while the girls fawn over the house.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is the backyard where our two sand puppies will run around...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: How cute!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And this is the sand bedrooms where a couple sand babies are napping...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And here's the sand nursery for them to play in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really admire your `sandy`work, Howard.
nodes.text_bbcode: I really admire your [color=#3b78e2][i]sandy[/i][/color]work, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Groan...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I think it's cute! Oh, and what's that over there?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's our friendly sand town! Come take a look!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, man, is that what Amanda and I sound like? I `am` getting sappy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, man, is that what Amanda and I sound like? I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] getting sappy!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's probably better we don't talk about it.
Amanda and Hector head back down to the beach and put their bags down.
Near them, Howard and $ZOE are sitting in the sand.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Welcome back. How was shopping?

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm done with you! I'm outta here!
Hector pinches himself...
And awakes to find Amanda by his side.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, Hector! You're awake! Are you okay? Maria and Jessica thought this would be a great joke.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But I don't think separating your body from your head is very funny!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Don't worry though. I'd love you even if you were only a head.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aww, Amanda... That's sweet. Hey, can we talk about us for a second?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course! What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Nothing. It's just... Amanda, I'm really happy to be with you, but there are times...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What kind of times?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, there are times when I don't want to go shopping, and I don't want to be called 'Hecky-Wecky'.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whew! Is that all? I thought you were talking about math.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: If you were that unhappy about it, you should have said something.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I didn't know I could. I've never been in a relationship before, and I didn't want to ruin it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So I did some things that made me unhappy and never said anything about them because I didn't want to make you sad or upset.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector, you make me so happy when it comes to big, important things. So small things like that don't matter to me.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You shouldn't ever feel like you can't tell me anything.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Are you okay now?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I have kind of a headache, but that's what happens when you hurt your subconscious.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I have no idea what you just said, but I think it's time to get you out of there.
Amanda digs him out, and they walk back to the bonfire party.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There you are, Hector! We were starting to get worried. Where'd you go?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: On a journey of sorts.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you learn something?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I learned a lot.
Hector reaches into his bag and pulls out Hector's Guide to Girls. He tosses it into the fire where the pages twist and crumble!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're burning that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah. It's about time. I'm a different person now than I was when I wrote it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you worked really hard on that. Are you sure you want to throw it away? What if you need another copy?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, it's always available in the store...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Besides, there are better things to do. Manda Panda, let's go burn some marshmallows and watch the stars!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay!
Congratulations! You played a great game! You really helped Hector figure himself out!
And you saved Amanda and Hector's relationship! You did a great job!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Hector punches Party Animal Hector in the face!
Hector kicks Party Animal Hector in the shins!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Exactly! You see how much better off you are now?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm free! I'm free!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I hate to point this out, but... You're not free yet.
Hector blinks...
And wakes up on the beach, buried in sand.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh. He's right.
At that moment, Amanda runs down to the beach and sits down beside Hector.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector! The beach is trying to eat you! I need to dig you out!

nodes.speaker: Hector
